cards.back: The relationship between performer and audience is central to the experience of dance

cards.front: Recall a key point about Performance & the Audience
cards.back: Different venues — studios, theatres, outdoor spaces — affect how a performance is presented and received

cards.front: Recall a key point about Performance & the Audience
cards.back: A proscenium arch theatre creates a clear separation between performer and audience, framing the dance like a picture

cards.front: Recall a key point about Performance & the Audience
cards.back: Thrust and in-the-round stages bring the audience closer, creating intimacy and changing the performer's focus

cards.front: Recall a key point about Performance & the Audience
cards.back: Site-specific performances use non-theatre spaces and respond directly to the environment, creating unique audience experiences

cards.front: Recall a key point about Performance & the Audience
cards.back: The audience-performer relationship involves energy exchange — the audience's attention and response affect the performer

cards.front: Recall a key point about Performance & the Audience
cards.back: Performance quality is the overall standard of a performance, shaped by physical, technical and expressive skills working together

cards.front: Recall a key point about Performance & the Audience
cards.back: A dancer must adapt their projection, focus and energy to suit the size and type of venue

cards.front: Recall a key point about Performance & the Audience
cards.back: Audience interpretation depends on their prior knowledge, cultural background and personal experience

cards.front: Recall a key point about Performance & the Audience
cards.back: Effective performers acknowledge the audience's presence while staying committed to the character and intention

cards.front: Recall a key point about Performance & the Audience
cards.back: GCSE Dance students perform in both studio and theatre settings and must understand how context affects their work

cards.front: Recall a key point about Performance & the Audience
cards.back: AQA 8236 assesses understanding of performance context and the ability to analyse how audiences experience dance
